/*
    DFPWM decoder implementation in JavaScript

upstream.author: polyzium
upstream.name: 1 bit per sample DFPWM audio
upstream.description: Response to Sychamis' DPCM experiment. Dynamic Filter Pulse Width Modulation (DFPWM) is a 1-bit-per-sample audio codec. It uses a low-pass filter that is dynamically adjusted by the predictor that detects the PWM duty cycle of the samples.
